faq.q: Do I need my own agent to attend a Ladner open house?
faq.a: No official source opened for this file requires it. BCFSA states a licensee must work for either the buyer or the seller, must inform consumers of the duties owed to clients and non-clients, and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional who represents another party.

faq.q: Does every listing on the Ladner open-houses page hold an open house?
faq.a: Not on the evidence of the cards read: five of the six fully read cards carried an open-house time block and one (a Ladner Rural farm listing) carried no open-house label or time at all, so treat an unlabelled card as a listing to confirm privately, not as an open house.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Ladner Open?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Ladner Open is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
